name: One Last Story
source:
Do a writer's last words mean anything to the living? 

A story about death and the (idealization or fear of a possible) future. 

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/one-last-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作家的遺言，對活著的人有什麼意義嗎？

一個關於死亡和未來的故事（或者說，是關於人們如何美化或畏懼某一種可能的未來）。

［摘自[url=https://meiri.itch.io/one-last-story]itch.io[/url]］
